title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 15, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.6 (Peaked November 15, 2026 at 18:06 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C2.8 (Peaked November 14, 2026 at 21:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 339 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Small burst of solar energy! 💥

Several active regions and sunspot groups are visible across the Sun today, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward eruption.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 335 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
